question: The Government of Karnataka organizes the _______ festival every year, which features an scintillating performances of dance, drama and music, is organized amidst the rocks and ruins that date back to hundreds of years, in the village situated near Vijaynagar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hampi Dance Utsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hampi Dance Utsav, also known as the** Hampi Utsav** or **Vijaya Utsav**, is organized by the **Government of Karnataka**.
 
• This festival showcases classical dance, drama, and music performances in the ancient village of Hampi, near Vijayanagar.
 
• Hampi, a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**, provides a historic and picturesque backdrop for the festival.
 
• The festival celebrates the cultural and historical richness of the **Vijayanagar Empire**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hampi:** Located in **Karnataka**, **Hampi **was once the capital of the **Vijayanagar Empire** and is now a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**.
 
• **Hampi Dance Utsav:** The festival draws performers and audiences from across the country, offering a mix of classical and folk art forms.
 
• **Nishagandhi Festival:** Held in Kerala, it is another cultural festival known for dance and music performances.
 
• **Mamallapuram Utsav:** Celebrated in Tamil Nadu, this festival features dance performances in the backdrop of ancient rock-cut sculptures.
 
• **Natyanjali Utsav:** A festival of classical dance celebrated in Tamil Nadu to honor **Lord Shiva**.
